args.title: Saltmarsh Foods: Warehouse automation in 2026 (3-bullet summary)
args.body:
- Newsletter: Saltmarsh Foods' latest issue covers "Warehouse automation in 2026" and links to the full article at blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/warehouse (companion piece at insights.saltmarsh.example/warehouse/companion).
- Article: Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
- Companion piece: The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
